3. Issue notice to the Respondent.
Mrs. Sangit, learned APP waives service for the State.
4. These proceedings arise out of CR No.0427 of 2024.

The FIR is lodged on 22 October 2024 at 17:13 hours by the Pachod Police Station,
Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar (Rural).
The date of occurrence of the alleged incident as stated in the FIR is 21 October 2024.

The FIR has been registered under Sections 30(2)(a), 27(3)(e), 26(2)(iv), 26(2)(ii) and 26(2)(i) of The Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 and Sections 123, 275, 274 and 223 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023 ("BNS").

sentences.text: that the issues involved are connected to the various other Applications which have been filed in this Court concerning  possession/supply/storage of the banned substances i.e. Gutka in its various forms.
As far as the present Application is concerned, it is stated that the Applicant's name is not ascribed in the FIR, however, surfaced from the statement of co-accused persons during the investigation.
It is alleged that the Applicant has supplied the contraband to the accused persons, who have allegedly purchased it from the Applicant.
In such view of the matter, this appears to be covered in order passed in Anticipatory Bail Application No.857 of 2025 and connected proceedings.
Learned Advocate for the Applicant would submit that the two accused persons as named in the FIR are enlarged on regular bail by the trial Court.

6. Considering the above, prima facie, this Applicant is entitled to protection in terms of the following order:-
 ORDER (i)

Until the adjourned date of hearing, in the event of arrest of the Applicant in connection with CR No. 0427 of 2024 registered with Pachod Police Station, Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar (Rural) for the offences punishable under Sections 30(2)(a), 27(3)(e), 26(2)(iv), 26(2)(ii) and 26(2)(i) of The Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 and Sections 123, 275, 274 and 223 of the BNS, the Applicant is directed to be 923-ABA-1248-2025.doc released on bail on his furnishing PR bond in the sum of Rs.20,000 (Rupees Twenty Thousand Only) with one or more sureties in the like amount.
(ii) The Applicant shall cooperate with the investigation and shall attend the concerned police station every Monday at 11:30 a.m., until further orders.
(iii) The Applicant shall furnish details of residential address and other contact details such as mobile number etc. to the concerned police station.
If there is any change in the contact details, the same shall be immediately intimated to the concerned police station.
(iv) The Applicant shall not leave the jurisdiction of the Court without prior permission/order of the Court, until further orders.
